Actor Vincent Pastore, Known for 'The Sopranos,' Dies at 80

Vincent Pastore, an actor best known for his role as Salvatore 'Big Pussy' Bonpensiero in the HBO series 'The Sopranos,' has died at the age of 80. His manager confirmed his death. Pastore also had roles in films such as 'Goodfellas' and 'Awakenings' in the early 1990s. He was often cast in roles playing mobsters and tough characters.
